protocol.title: Underlying (OKX perp) order-flow toxicity -> subsequent realized volatility and signed return: wrapper-free rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-65 (identical Spearman rank-IC statistic) but a different, on-charter signal source: the underlying perp tape rather than the options tape; no options surface needed; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the underlying-tape complement to EVAL-65 (options tape) that is runnable pre-threshold
protocol.signal: causal per-bar signed-aggressor order-flow imbalance (buy_vol - sell_vol)/(buy_vol + sell_vol) from real OKX perp trades, and its absolute (tox) variant, expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: over the next H perp bars: rv = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)); signed_return = sum(log-return) (strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, target_forward_k)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (surface + perp candles + OKX perp trades); no new acquisition, no network; carries its own pre-registered perp-tape floor

floor.note: EVAL-70 measures a perp-tape order-flow signal, so it carries its own pre-registered floor (perp trades/candles/span). This is NOT a weakening of the EVAL-64 options-surface floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is reused verbatim there.
